name: Where We Belong
source: In Where We Belong, you step into the shoes of a young man who stumbles upon ancient ruins, only to be transported to a magical realm through a mysterious portal. Now trapped at an extraordinary institute, you must uncover the secrets of this world while facing trials that will test your abilities and reveal your true potential.
